draftQuotes.text: Tyranitar at 14 is exceptional value, filling three needs at once: Sand Stream weather setter, premier physical attacker (134 base Attack), and a bulky Rock/Dark defensive backbone that gets a SpD boost in its own sand.
Excadrill completes the sand core with Tyranitar's Sand Stream, giving me a fast Ground/Steel sweeper under Sand Rush that threatens the Fire, Steel, and Electric types across opponent rosters.

terminalQuote.text: I would consolidate the three weakest budget picks (Absol 1, Sandaconda 2, Chandelure 6 = 9 points) into one better Pokémon at the draft rather than waiting for the trade window to fix them — a 9-point Water resist like Gyarados or Milotic would have addressed the rain hole from day one.

Sandstorm then KOs Talonflame at 1 HP. Combined Metagross damage (~74-127% with sandstorm) likely KOs it too. This play is robust: if Metagross Protects, I still eliminate Talonflame via Sash break + sandstorm rather than wasting both attacks. If Talonflame Tailwinds or Brave Birds (NVE), Excadrill survives and I likely sweep both foes. Tyranitar survives Meteor Mash at 9-35% HP and gets Rock Slide off before fainting.
